annotations.title: Get the account's spending budget status

description: Read-only view of the agent-wallet budget authorized with phantom_authorize_budget: allocated / spent / remaining USDC units (6 decimals), daily cap, spent today, funder wallet and binding mode. Use before spending to check remaining headroom, or to audit an agent's budget. Requires the account's PHANTOM_API_KEY.
name: phantom_get_budget_status

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.
